Title: Public Preview: Application Insight in UK West, Germany West Central, Switzerland West and Australia Central 2

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor Application Insights is now publicly available for customers to start testing in UK West, Germany West Central, Switzerland West and Australia Central 2 regions.
Application Insights is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

See all available regions.
